SELECT
  'null_amount' AS check_name,
  COUNT_IF(amount IS NULL) AS failing_rows
FROM workspace.exam_x2b425.dq_orders
UNION ALL
SELECT
  'negative_amount' AS check_name,
  COUNT_IF(amount < 0) AS failing_rows
FROM workspace.exam_x2b425.dq_orders
UNION ALL
SELECT
  'duplicate_order_id' AS check_name,
  COUNT(*) - COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS failing_rows
FROM workspace.exam_x2b425.dq_orders
UNION ALL
SELECT
  'orphan_customer' AS check_name,
  COUNT(*) AS failing_rows
FROM workspace.exam_x2b425.dq_orders o
LEFT JOIN workspace.exam_x2b425.dq_customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
WHERE c.customer_id IS NULL
UNION ALL
SELECT
  'future_order_date' AS check_name,
  COUNT_IF(order_date > DATE '2026-11-01') AS failing_rows
FROM workspace.exam_x2b425.dq_orders
UNION ALL
SELECT
  'invalid_status' AS check_name,
  COUNT_IF(status NOT IN ('new', 'paid', 'shipped', 'cancelled') OR status IS NULL) AS failing_rows
FROM workspace.exam_x2b425.dq_orders
SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_rows, COUNT(order_id) AS non_null_orders, COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS distinct_orders, COUNT(*) - COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS diff FROM workspace.exam_x2b425.dq_orders
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM workspace.exam_x2b425.dq_orders WHERE amount IS NULL
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM workspace.exam_x2b425.dq_orders WHERE amount < 0
SELECT amount, COUNT(*) FROM workspace.exam_x2b425.dq_orders WHERE amount < 0 GROUP BY amount
SELECT COUNT_IF(amount >= 0) AS non_neg, COUNT_IF(amount < 0) AS neg, COUNT_IF(amount IS NULL) AS is_null, COUNT(*) AS total FROM workspace.exam_x2b425.dq_orders
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM workspace.exam_x2b425.dq_orders WHERE customer_id NOT IN (SELECT customer_id FROM workspace.exam_x2b425.dq_customers WHERE customer_id IS NOT NULL)

SELECT
  (SELECT COUNT_IF(customer_id IS NULL) FROM workspace.exam_x2b425.dq_orders) AS null_cust_orders,
  (SELECT COUNT_IF(customer_id IS NULL) FROM workspace.exam_x2b425.dq_customers) AS null_cust_custs

SELECT
  COUNT_IF(order_date > DATE '2026-11-01') AS strictly_after,
  COUNT_IF(order_date >= DATE '2026-11-01') AS on_or_after,
  COUNT_IF(order_date = DATE '2026-11-01') AS on_date,
  COUNT_IF(order_date <= DATE '2026-11-01') AS on_or_before
FROM workspace.exam_x2b425.dq_orders
SELECT MIN(order_date), MAX(order_date) FROM workspace.exam_x2b425.dq_orders WHERE order_date > DATE '2026-11-01'
SELECT status, COUNT(*) FROM workspace.exam_x2b425.dq_orders GROUP BY status

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE workspace.exam_x2b425.dq_report (
  check_name STRING,
  failing_rows BIGINT
)

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE workspace.exam_x2b425.dq_report AS
SELECT
  CAST('null_amount' AS STRING) AS check_name,
  CAST(COUNT_IF(amount IS NULL) AS BIGINT) AS failing_rows
FROM workspace.exam_x2b425.dq_orders
UNION ALL
SELECT
  CAST('negative_amount' AS STRING) AS check_name,
  CAST(COUNT_IF(amount < 0) AS BIGINT) AS failing_rows
FROM workspace.exam_x2b425.dq_orders
UNION ALL
SELECT
  CAST('duplicate_order_id' AS STRING) AS check_name,
  CAST(COUNT(*) - COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS BIGINT) AS failing_rows
FROM workspace.exam_x2b425.dq_orders
UNION ALL
SELECT
  CAST('orphan_customer' AS STRING) AS check_name,
  CAST(COUNT(*) AS BIGINT) AS failing_rows
FROM workspace.exam_x2b425.dq_orders o
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
  SELECT 1 FROM workspace.exam_x2b425.dq_customers c WHERE c.customer_id = o.customer_id
)
UNION ALL
SELECT
  CAST('future_order_date' AS STRING) AS check_name,
  CAST(COUNT_IF(order_date > DATE '2026-11-01') AS BIGINT) AS failing_rows
FROM workspace.exam_x2b425.dq_orders
UNION ALL
SELECT
  CAST('invalid_status' AS STRING) AS check_name,
  CAST(COUNT_IF(status NOT IN ('new', 'paid', 'shipped', 'cancelled') OR status IS NULL) AS BIGINT) AS failing_rows
FROM workspace.exam_x2b425.dq_orders
